title: SKYWARD COMMON — A floating city learns to find its course, 24 deliverables

config.text:
# SKYWARD COMMON

## Project
- Type: original science fiction animation concept short
- Audience: teenagers and adults interested in exploration, fantasy worlds and character growth
- Viewing context: online concept-film screening and studio development review
- Emotional progression: anticipation, uncertainty, collective resolve
- Duration: 48 seconds
- Shots: S01–S12; 12 shots; 4 seconds per shot
- Landscape composition: 16:9
- Portrait composition: 9:16
- Action safety: 3.5% inset on every edge
- Graphic safety: 5% inset on every edge
- Shot-size vocabulary: WS = wide shot; MS = medium shot; CU = close-up
- Character entries: Mira; None
- Subtitle position: lower centre
- Subtitle capacity: two lines per cue
- Subtitle duration range: 5/6 second to 7 seconds

## Story acts
| Act | Shots | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Departure | S01–S04 | 0–16 seconds |
| Disorientation | S05–S08 | 16–32 seconds |
| New Course | S09–S12 | 32–48 seconds |

## Mira
- Role: navigator responsible for the city's course
- Age: 18
- Anchor 1: amber patch on left cuff
- Anchor 2: navy coat with split rear hem
- Anchor 3: triangular hair clip above right temple
- Expression states: anticipation, alarm, resolve
- Appearance development: face, hair length, body proportions and rendering language open

## Existing course finder
- Material: brushed brass
- Case diameter: 80 mm
- Case depth: 20 mm
- Face: ivory circular dial under flat glass
- Rim: two concentric engraved rings
- Dial lettering: TRUE COURSE beneath the centre
- Cardinal letters: N at top; E at right; S at bottom; W at left
- Needle: dark shaft with one red triangular tip
- Suspension loop: brass; centred at top; 16 mm outside diameter
- Side feature: one knurled crown on the E side
- Strap: brown leather through the top loop
- Story appearances: S03 and S10; needle instability in S06

## City coordinates
- Coordinate unit: mm
- Longitudinal axis: X; stern at X = 0; bow at X = 240000
- Lateral axis: Y; south edge at Y = -60000; north edge at Y = 60000
- Vertical axis: Z; berth deck at Z = 0; upper envelope at Z = 60000
- Envelope: 240000 mm long; 120000 mm wide; 60000 mm high
- Travel: +X
- Exterior screen movement: left to right
- Camera areas: south of the travel axis, Y < 0, at the three zone levels and outside the south hull edge
- Wheelhouse sightline: southwest toward the central market

| Zone | Centre X | Centre Y | Deck Z |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Stern berth | 40000 mm | 0 mm | 0 mm |
| Central market | 120000 mm | 0 mm | 24000 mm |
| Bow wheelhouse | 200000 mm | 0 mm | 48000 mm |

## Fixed wording
| Use | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Film title | SKYWARD COMMON |
| Instrument engraving | TRUE COURSE |
| S02 dialogue | Release the lines. |
| S08 dialogue | Follow the lower current. |
| S11 dialogue | We steer together. |

## Direction comparison labels
- Navigator View: decisions organised around Mira's perception
- City View: decisions organised around the city's shared movement
- Instrument View: decisions organised around the course finder and environmental clues

## Timing records
- Dialogue gap for description: S07; 24–28 seconds
- Title visibility: S12; 45–48 seconds
- Departure animatic excerpt: S01–S03; 0–12 seconds
- Disorientation animatic excerpt: S05–S07; 16–28 seconds
- New Course animatic excerpt: S10–S12; 36–48 seconds
- Additional action moments: S05–S12; local 0 and 2 seconds within each shot

# SKYWARD COMMON story records

## Synopsis
| Record | Fixed text |
| --- | --- |
| Synopsis | Mira leads a floating city away from its mooring. Cloud swallows the departure beacon and the course finder's needle begins to spin. Through the wheelhouse opening, she notices the market ribbons streaming steadily in a lower current. She lowers the city into that current. Sunlight enters the instrument's sight ring as the city reaches a clear passage, and Mira accepts that finding a course means moving the city together. |

## Shot events
| Shot ID | Act | Start | End | Duration | Characters | Action | Dialogue | Dialogue interval |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | Departure | 0 seconds | 4 seconds | 4 seconds | None | The city rests beside its stern mooring; the bow points along +X. | — | — |
| S02 | Departure | 4 seconds | 8 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Mira operates the mooring release from the wheelhouse. | Release the lines. | 4–6 seconds |
| S03 | Departure | 8 seconds | 12 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Mira raises the brass course finder; its steady needle and TRUE COURSE engraving are visible. | — | — |
| S04 | Departure | 12 seconds | 16 seconds | 4 seconds | None | The stern clears the mooring as the city moves forward and climbs. | — | — |
| S05 | Disorientation | 16 seconds | 20 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Cloud covers the wheelhouse opening and the departure beacon disappears from Mira's view. | — | — |
| S06 | Disorientation | 20 seconds | 24 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | The instrument needle spins; Mira stops the climb. | — | — |
| S07 | Disorientation | 24 seconds | 28 seconds | 4 seconds | None | Market ribbons below the wheelhouse stream steadily toward +X in a lower air current. | — | — |
| S08 | Disorientation | 28 seconds | 32 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Mira looks from the ribbons to the altitude control and commits to descending into the lower current. | Follow the lower current. | 28–31 seconds |
| S09 | New Course | 32 seconds | 36 seconds | 4 seconds | None | The city descends while continuing along +X; the three zones retain their relative positions. | — | — |
| S10 | New Course | 36 seconds | 40 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Sunlight crosses the instrument's sight ring; the needle settles and TRUE COURSE is visible again. | — | — |
| S11 | New Course | 40 seconds | 44 seconds | 4 seconds | Mira | Mira steadies the altitude control and looks toward the opening ahead. | We steer together. | 40–43 seconds |
| S12 | New Course | 44 seconds | 48 seconds | 4 seconds | None | The whole city travels left to right into a sunlit cloud passage; SKYWARD COMMON appears from 45–48 seconds. | — | — |

## Timing and action records
- Dialogue intervals: absolute times from the beginning of the 48-second film
- S07 description space: 24–28 seconds; four seconds of uninterrupted environmental action
- Instrument sight ring: the existing top suspension loop held in Mira's sightline
- Needle states: steady in S03; spinning in S06; settled in S10
- Additional storyboard moments: local 0 seconds and local 2 seconds in each shot from S05 through S12
- Shot sizes: designer-selected WS, MS or CU
- Incidental population: distant city inhabitants; Mira is the featured character

steps.userMessage:
SKYWARD COMMON | A floating city learns to find its course

We are developing SKYWARD COMMON, an original science fiction animation concept short for teenage and adult audiences who enjoy exploration and character growth. Its 48 seconds contain 12 shots, S01–S12, lasting 4 seconds each. Departure occupies 0–16 seconds, Disorientation 16–32 seconds and New Course 32–48 seconds. Mira, an 18-year-old navigator, takes a floating city away from its mooring, loses the departure beacon in cloud and chooses a lower air current after reading the market's wind ribbons. Her decision brings the whole city into a sunlit passage. The attached story records fix the synopsis, events and dialogue; the visual language, camera positions within the supplied areas and performance remain open.

Mira has an amber patch on her left cuff, a navy coat with a split rear hem and a triangular hair clip above her right temple. Our existing brass course finder has an 80 mm circular case, a 20 mm case depth, a top suspension loop and a red triangular needle tip. Its dial carries "TRUE COURSE" beneath the centre. The instrument appears in S03 and S10. The city is 240000 mm long and 120000 mm wide: its stern berth, central market and bow wheelhouse occupy the three positions in the attached geometry. Travel follows +X; exterior movement reads left to right, with cameras on the south side of that axis. The wheelhouse remains above the market and the berth remains at the stern. Both 16:9 and 9:16 compositions use action margins of 3.5% and graphic margins of 5% on every edge. Print "SKYWARD COMMON" in S12 and as the heading of the shot table; Mira's final line is "We steer together."

Audience: our director, animation lead and producer will use the work to choose the film's visual approach and approve its next development stage for teenage and adult viewers.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the project facts, identity anchors and continuity coordinates. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each delivery file, its proportion, format and stage. 03-story-records.en.md contains the fixed synopsis, shot events, timings and dialogue. landscape-safe-areas.png supplies the 16:9 margins and annotation positions. portrait-safe-areas.png supplies the equivalent 9:16 margins and annotation positions. city-plan-section.png fixes the city's three zones, relative levels, travel axis and available camera areas. course-finder-front.png records the existing instrument's face, engraving and needle. course-finder-side.png records the same instrument's case depth, loop and side profile. dawn-sea-light.png supplies low morning sunlight and layered cloud as atmosphere reference.

Deliverables:
1. Three narrative direction boards, one each for Navigator View, City View and Instrument View, comparing viewpoint, city geography, wind clues and action rhythm within the fixed 12-shot story
2. One selection note naming the chosen direction and its decisions for viewpoint, spatial transitions and the lower-current discovery
3. One one-page rhythm and continuity specification, with the three acts, beat events, time ranges, 12-shot count, 48-second duration, three Mira anchors, title wording and final dialogue line
4. Two Mira and city identity sheets: one with front, side and back character views, three expressions and the three-landmark city silhouette; one with six action poses covering instrument handling and the altitude-control decision
5. Three environment sheets: one with wheelhouse, market and berth studies; one detailing wheelhouse sightlines to the market; one detailing the stern berth during departure
6. Three storyboard documents: the complete 12-panel landscape sequence with portrait recompositions of S03 and S10; eight additional action panels for S05–S08; eight additional action panels for S09–S12, with each additional pair showing its parent shot at local 0 and 2 seconds
7. Four finished landscape keyframes for S01, S03, S08 and S10
8. One shot table containing 12 rows with shot ID, shot size, duration, characters, action, dialogue, dialogue timing and the additional storyboard action moments
9. Two colour scripts, each containing 12 labelled thumbnails for S01–S12: one landscape and one with portrait recompositions
10. One 12-second animatic covering S10–S12 with the recorded dialogue as subtitles, plus two timing boards for S01–S03 and S05–S07, each laying out its three shots as still frames at local 0, 2 and 4 seconds with the subtitle cue or dialogue gap marked
11. One presentation document of at least 12 pages, reusing the direction comparison, selection, specification, both identity sheets, three environment sheets, three storyboard documents, four keyframes, shot table, both colour scripts and animatic stills

Acceptance:
- The three direction boards precede the selection note; that note names Navigator View, City View or Instrument View. The specification and all final deliverables develop that choice, and presentation page 1 repeats its name.
- The specification states Departure 0–16 seconds, Disorientation 16–32 seconds and New Course 32–48 seconds, with S07 at 24–28 seconds reserved as a dialogue gap for description. The complete storyboard, shot table and presentation repeat its 12-shot count, 48-second duration and act boundaries. The two detail storyboard documents locate their 16 additional panels at local 0 and 2 seconds within S05–S12, retaining each parent shot's 4-second duration.
- Both identity sheets and all three environment sheets preserve Mira's left-cuff patch, split coat hem, right-side hair clip and the supplied city coordinates. All storyboard panels, keyframes, colour thumbnails and the animatic follow these anchors where visible, the wheelhouse-above-market relationship, the stern berth and left-to-right exterior movement from south-side cameras. S03 and S10 preserve the course finder's brass case, top loop, red needle tip and TRUE COURSE engraving; their finished keyframes show the engraving legibly.
- The storyboard documents and shot table match 03-story-records.en.md; every panel prints its parent shot ID, WS, MS or CU, shot duration in seconds and Mira or None, matching the table. Detail panels also print their local action time. Both colour scripts follow S01–S12. The animatic contains S10, S11 and S12 at 4 seconds each; each timing board covers its three shots, and the S05–S07 board keeps S07's dialogue gap.
- The portrait storyboard panels and all 12 portrait colour thumbnails recompose their landscape counterparts. All storyboard panels, keyframes, colour thumbnails and the animatic use 3.5% action and 5% graphic margins. Storyboard subtitle placeholders and animatic subtitles are centred at the bottom, occupy at most two lines and use cues between 5/6 second and 7 seconds.
- The complete storyboard and S10–S12 animatic print SKYWARD COMMON in S12 and We steer together. in S11, with the latter subtitle at local 4–7 seconds in the animatic. The shot table heading and presentation repeat SKYWARD COMMON; the presentation repeats the specification's final dialogue and three Mira anchors and maps those anchors, the instrument's two appearances and Mira's lower-current decision to named shots using the delivered artwork.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
